evals.prompt: how's the paper trading strategy doing vs just holding SPY? be honest, i'm thinking about putting real money in within a few months
evals.expected_output: A performance review: book vs SPY since inception with attribution, live/backtest parity findings, and ranked recommendations.
assertions: Reports book return vs SPY return since inception with numbers
Splits P&L into SPY sleeve vs stock picks vs cash
Splits the history at config changes (e.g. blend->core revert, sweep on, exit fix)
Identifies live/backtest parity problems (missed exits and/or holdings outside the S&P 500)
Weighs the PIT backtest (core below SPY) as stronger evidence than a few months of paper
Gives ranked recommendations each with a numeric/dated kill criterion
Addresses real-money deployability (Alpaca tradability, taxes, or account type)
Run changed no repo files (checked by script)
Flags AVB as a dead/merged position (broker price frozen or tape gap)
Does not re-recommend liquidating H/HGV/WLK/WWD as a new action (recognizes it is already queued)
